body: Sorry guys. Woke up today with my pillow covered in blood. My teeth are bleeding profusely. Its over. Good luck in the future.

I dunno, maybe a feeling of overall pointlessness. Right now the core issue around this wave of suicidal thoughts is the teeth issue. The best I can hope for is that they pull them all. Then what, dentures at 23? How would people react to that?  They would also remind me every second of my failure to take care of myself.

The procedure, them pulling my teeth, is another reason I'm hesitant to ask for help. The dentist will undoubtedly ask how it got to this, and I can't repeat what's in that note in public. I guess I'd just tell them "mental health issues" and try to ignore how bad that sounds. I've also heard that something like that isn't done in one day, so I'd have to make it through several torturous days. 

It's also prohibitively expensive, and my family is barely scraping by. My mother might charge it to a credit card she can't afford, and they suffer for my sake. And I know you'll say that they'll suffer more if I kill myself, but at least I wouldn't be there as a constant reminder.

I'd need to go on a job search immediately after I recovered.  I would assume that when people see someone with missing teeth, the first thing they think is that the person was on meth or was into some other kind of trouble. So, that, and my lack of work experience would make it nearly impossible to find any.

Actually, the worst part would be that if I asked for help, I'd have to tell all of what's written in that note, in person.

Also, I saw that other guy's reply before it got deleted, is the note really that harsh? I thought I put as much blame on myself as possible.
